translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of sprains, bruises, muscle pain, joint pain, pain from fractures, low back pain, stiff shoulders, and chilblains.
translation.usage: Adults apply the patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: infants under 30 months of age; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine or to cosmetics; people with severe moist skin or erosion; children. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash; redness; itching; swelling. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
